title: rumex aquaticus var. helolapathum
intro: Rumex aquaticus var. helolapathum, commonly known as water dock or Indian rhubarb, is a perennial aquatic plant native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rumex aquaticus var. helolapathum include reducing fever, alleviating pain and inflammation, and treating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
